posts.title: 2026 Beautillion Class Officially Announced
posts.excerpt: Twenty-two young men have been selected to join this year's class following a competitive application and interview process.
posts.body: Twenty-two young men have been selected to join this year's Beautillion class following a competitive application and interview process. The class will begin orientation this month and culminate in the formal presentation ceremony in the spring.

posts.title: Scholarship Fund Surpasses $250,000 in Lifetime Giving
posts.excerpt: Thanks to our sponsors and community partners, the Academy has now awarded a quarter-million dollars in scholarships since inception.
posts.body: Thanks to the generosity of our sponsors and community partners, the Academy has now awarded a quarter-million dollars in scholarships since inception, supporting Beaux as they pursue higher education across the country.

posts.title: Beaux Complete Citywide Community Service Day
posts.excerpt: This year's class logged over 400 combined service hours across five community partner organizations in a single weekend.
posts.body: This year's class logged over 400 combined service hours across five community partner organizations in a single weekend, from food banks to youth mentoring programs.
